description: This Java class, NodeELResolver, defines custom property resolution behavior for XML DOM Nodes within an expression language (EL) context. It interprets property strings as XPath expressions, evaluates them against provided nodes, and returns matching nodes or lists of nodes. It is designed to be a read-only ELResolver, facilitating XPath-based property access on DOM Nodes.

classes.name: NodeELResolver
classes.description: Custom ELResolver for resolving properties on DOM Nodes using XPath expressions, supporting read-only access.

methods.name: getCommonPropertyType
methods.description: Returns String.class if the base object is resolvable (a DOM Node), indicating properties are strings.

methods.name: getFeatureDescriptors
methods.description: Returns null; no feature descriptors provided.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns Node.class if the base is resolvable, indicating the property type.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Evaluates the XPath expression (property as string) against the DOM node and returns matching nodes or list of nodes.

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating the resolver is read-only.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Throws PropertyNotWritableException since the resolver is read-only.
